title: Electric sauna stove wiring not checked in 10 years

mitigation.action: Electrician checks the sauna stove's supply cable, terminal box, thermostat and overheat limiter and replaces heat-damaged parts

known_quirks: Sauna stoves caused 109 of the about 2,200 electrical fires in Finland in 2020 (Tukes)
The silicone-insulated stove cable turns brittle in the heat above the stove and shorts at the terminal box
Towels or a bench left on the stove, and a stuck thermostat, are the usual fire starts
Stoves over 20 years old have corroded heating elements that trip the fuses or the residual-current device
why_hint: DRAFT: The home has an electric sauna stove in a house from before 2006, and no electrician has checked the installation in the last 10 years. Tukes counts sauna stoves among the top three causes of electrical fires.
benefit_hint: DRAFT: A stove wiring check finds a brittle cable or a stuck thermostat before it starts a sauna fire.
